description: For research sessions: one x402 payment of $1 returns a pass token that unlocks every paid tool here for 24 hours (up to 40 successful calls; four briefs alone list at $1). Then set the MCP client header "Authorization: Bearer <pass>" or pass _meta["lumen/pass"]. PAID: $1.00, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/pass/day.
